Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

easyNIS (development version)

  • The real-data workflow probe discovers diagnosis and POA fields from lazy query schemas with colnames(), so those fields are retained by nis_design().

  • The quality probe now saves nested pkgcheck and goodpractice failure results and captured warnings in an ignored local artifact while keeping nested condition text out of its public receipt. Receipts include numeric failed-check, R CMD check error, and captured-warning counts. Prep failures and unknown check statuses are no longer reported as passing.

  • Corrected the procedure-timing help text so manual HTML validates.

  • Reduce cyclomatic complexity in diagnosis sensitivity summaries and HCUP labeling without changing their results.

Project metadata

  • Set the project license to GNU AGPL-3.0-only, update author names and ORCIDs across package metadata.

New features

  • Reduced cyclomatic complexity in data opening and procedure timing helpers without changing their results or lazy DuckDB query behavior.

  • The experimental pre-2016 ICD-9 layout notice from nis_open() now appears once per R session.

  • Internal helpers now split validation, cost adjustment, and synthetic fixture construction in nis_cost() and nis_example() while preserving their existing behavior.

  • Refactored internal CCSR mapping helpers to keep cyclomatic complexity within the repository limit without changing nis_ccsr_codes() behavior.

  • Refactored new-study scaffolding and model-preflight helpers to keep cyclomatic complexity within the repository limit without changing behavior.

  • nis_open() combines annual Parquet files with Hive year partitions and returns YEAR as integer, rejecting invalid year values with a file-specific error.

  • nis_design() warns when annualized valid-design data represented in DQTR have fewer than four quarters, and explains how to exclude or separately reweight those years. It also warns when a 2015 cohort contains only ICD-9-coded quarters (Q1–Q3) or only the ICD-10-coded quarter (Q4), and informs when DQTR is missing so the 2015 split cannot be checked.

  • nis_cost() records charge/CCR fields, CPI-U source and multipliers, base year, invalid CCR and missing charge counts, and adjusted-output meanings. Zero or negative CCR values now produce NA in cost_adj (previously zero CCR produced zero cost and negative CCR produced a negative cost); one informational message reports how many rows have missing or invalid CCR (nis_design() reports cohort rows only). Use nis_cost_provenance() on its result or the nis_design() survey design.

  • Added nis_prday_completeness() for unweighted PRDAY completeness summaries by year and matched procedure slot.

  • Added nis_flag_pr_timing() for procedure timing flags.

  • Added nis_attrition() for cohort attrition summaries.

  • nis_open() now reads Parquet natively with DuckDB; DuckDB-backed lazy transformations are used throughout. The engine argument was removed entirely; callers should omit it regardless of the value they previously passed.

  • Added nis_audit_code_transition() to summarize code-system transitions.

  • Added nis_flag_dx_position() and nis_dx_sensitivity() for descriptive point estimates; these are not design-based estimates.

  • nis_suppress() now accepts data frames with count_col, weighted_cols, and by, and supports single-dimension complementary suppression.

  • nis_suppress() accepts hospital_col to mask cells based on fewer than two contributing hospitals; nis_cell_counts() computes unweighted discharge and year-scoped hospital counts from record-level data or an nis_design().

  • nis_suppress() now suppresses zero discharge counts at or below the threshold and rejects missing, non-finite, negative, or fractional data-frame count values.

  • nis_comorbidity() now uses aligned DXPOAn fields when available. Y and W count as present on admission, N and U do not, and other values are unknown, including invalid UTF-8 values. Missing POA columns retain the prior assumed-present behavior and now warn with the affected diagnosis slots; POA-dependent comorbidities may include conditions acquired in hospital. AHRQ requires POA to assign 18 of 38 measures and returns missing results when required POA information is absent (User Guide). medicalcoder 0.10.0’s exemption mapping covers AHRQ FY2022–FY2026 and reports consistent exemption status across those releases, but does not adjust exemption status for discharge date. Exempt-code results can therefore differ slightly from AHRQ software across fiscal years.

  • Refactored code-transition auditing, cell counts, and attrition summaries into internal helpers without changing their results or validation behavior.

  • Refactored nis_design() and nis_reweight() into private validation and preparation helpers without changing survey design behavior.

Maintenance

  • Readiness finds CI runs by the current commit SHA, so successful checks on another branch at the same commit are recognized while all existing success requirements remain in place.
  • Refactored nis_suppress() into internal helpers; behavior is unchanged.

easyNIS 0.2.0

Highlights

  • Replaced the archived API with lazy annual Parquet opening, ICD-10 prefix flags, a domain survey design, HCUP labels, CPI-adjusted charges and costs, cell suppression, and an invented six-year example fixture.
  • Added a Getting started guide, a guide to porting existing NIS studies, and an analyst workflow note.

New features

  • Added codemeta.json; regenerate it from DESCRIPTION with Rscript tools/probe/update-codemeta.R after changing package metadata.

  • Quoted the survey package name in DESCRIPTION and avoided duplicate arguments when constructing the 2023 charge warning.

  • nis_open() supports 2012 onward. nis_flag_dx() and nis_flag_pr() match literal prefixes separately in each code slot; supplied prefixes ignore case, periods, and spaces, while stored codes are compared byte for byte without text normalization, so malformed UTF-8 cannot raise a matching error.

  • Added experimental ICD-9 prefix flags with an explicit system = "icd9" option, metadata guards, and invented historical and split-2015 fixtures. ICD-10 remains the default.

  • nis_comorbidity() adds AHRQ Elixhauser Refined condition flags and mortality/readmission index scores through the suggested medicalcoder package. It accepts a collected data frame or an nis_design() result.

  • nis_ccsr_codes() reads a user-supplied HCUP DXCCSR or PRCCSR reference file (Excel via readxl or comma-separated) and returns ICD-10 codes in selected CCSR categories, optionally restricted to the default inpatient assignment. The codes can be passed to nis_flag_dx() or nis_flag_pr().

Survey design and weighting

  • nis_design() reports aggregate exclusions for invalid design fields and affected years, stores the counts in the nis_excluded design attribute, and documents why rows with invalid YEAR, HOSP_NIS, NIS_STRATUM, or DISCWT cannot be represented in the supplied survey design. Exclusions happen before cohort filtering and do not imply zero population weight or unbiased estimates.
  • nis_design() warns when charges are entirely missing for a year or when that year has hospitals but no cohort discharges. annualize divides by the number of distinct YEAR values, so a partial year counts as one.
  • Added experimental nis_reweight() to multiply cohort survey weights while retaining placeholder rows. It preserves column labels when rebuilding designs, including after comorbidity scoring. Weights are matched by position; call the function once. Weighted totals after reweighting are not national counts, and its placeholder variance field does not provide survey variance estimation. An optional commented WeightIt/cobalt example is in the study template.

Disclosure control

  • nis_suppress() also masks the overall (add_overall()) cell in any row where a by-group cell is masked. It marks that secondary mask Masked, unless the overall cell is itself at or below the threshold.
  • For continuous2 statistic rows, suppression uses the displayed output column’s non-missing count and errors when that count is missing, ambiguous, or non-finite. Other derivable cells, such as column totals across levels, are not masked; review tables before sharing.

Study template

  • Quarto study reports handle empty cohorts, one-level exposures, constant outcomes, and unusable model matrices with explicit status messages. Models use complete-case preflight; single-year reports omit the year adjustment, and DOCX trend tables display years without thousands separators.
  • Report caches include study definitions, external data-root identity, report inputs, output format, and rendering dependencies.
  • The template includes an optional, commented propensity-weighting example; both WeightIt and cobalt must be installed to use it.

Documentation

  • Added a Getting started guide covering file opening, flags, survey design, weighted tables, models, primary-cell suppression, and study scaffolding; runnable examples for exported helpers use invented fixtures, with the slower optional comorbidity example marked donttest.
  • Added a vignette on porting existing NIS study code, a short tidyverse pipeline README, grouped pkgdown reference pages, and package citation metadata.
  • Added issue templates, a privacy-aware pull request checklist, Contributor Covenant, security reporting guidance, and contributor instructions.
  • Added CI workflows for linting, test coverage, and study-template rendering. The pkgdown site is published at https://msaadasif.github.io/easyNIS/ on pushes to main.

Experimental and unverified

  • The placeholder-row survey method is experimental and must agree with the full-data design on estimates, standard errors, and degrees of freedom.
  • ICD-9 support is experimental. Historical layout facts beyond the documented 2015 Q1–Q3/Q4 split are assumptions and have not been verified against official HCUP documentation or licensed data.
  • NIS 2023 layout support is experimental and UNVERIFIED against official HCUP 2023 documentation and real 2023 data. It assumes TOTCHG_2023, the removal of HOSP_REGION and HOSP_DIVISION, and sequential NIS_STRATUM based on secondary notes. nis_open() accepts files without the geography columns and keeps TOTCHG_2023 separate from TOTCHG; queries containing it receive a once-per-session warning because HCUP’s national-estimate adjustment makes it incomparable with earlier-year charges. nis_design() and nis_cost() accept charges = "TOTCHG_2023" to opt in; pooling requires an explicit mutate(). Hospital and stratum IDs remain qualified by year.
  • nis_comorbidity() is ICD-10 only, does not use present-on-admission values, and treats I10_DX1 as the principal diagnosis. Its output is not expected to match the Stata-derived ynel* and elixsum columns. Rows without a usable I10_DX* code, including ICD-9-era discharges, receive NA and a warning rather than zeros.
  • HCUP CCSR file layouts are UNVERIFIED; no CCSR content is bundled. Malformed single-quoted CSV rows and non-ICD-10 codes are rejected.
